messages:
jamal: kicking off Q2 capacity sprint—need to lock tranche allocations for hosted API. thinking 3 tranches: baseline reserve, burst pool, regional safety stock. want buy/lease mix recs by EOD.
anya: baseline looks like we need 1.2k GPU-hours/day average, plus 4x microburst headroom. if we don't buy, leases will cost ~1.6x but give flexibility.
katie: finance note: committed vs opex mix affects Q2 runway. we can absorb up to $450k in committed purchases this quarter without runway hit. otherwise prefer 12-mo lease.
maria: region constraints: APAC rack lead time 8–12 weeks; EU availability decent. suggest shifting burst pool to EU/EAST and safety stock in US-WEST.
sre-lead: network/egress concern—if we move more traffic to EU, peering costs jump 30%. also need cross-region failover plan for KV cache.
ops-bot: metric snapshot: avg qps=2.1k, 99p latency=120ms, daily token-hours=28M (past 7d)
anya: here's a quick tranche sketch:
```
tranche A: reserved baseline = 900 GPU-hrs/day (buy preferred)
tranche B: burst pool = 600 GPU-hrs/day (short-term lease + spot)
tranche C: regional safety = 300 GPU-hrs/day (split EU:US 60/40)
```
jamal: prefer moving 150 safety-hours to US-WEST if networking costs covered. @katie can we model egress delta?
katie: yes, I'll run egress delta and publish a 3-scenario P&L by lunchtime. low/med/high traffic.
maria: ops ask: can we shift some embedding traffic to quantized small models to reduce GPU-hours? that could cut demand by ~18% during bursts.
finance: if we commit to a buy for 50% of tranche A, capex looks like $320k this quarter, vs $480k if we buy full. leaning buy half + lease rest.
anya: operationally, recommend: buy 450 GPU-hrs/day baseline equivalent (mix of permanent machines), lease rest of baseline+burst for 3-6 month window. keep safety stock in regional racks (hot spare nodes).
sre-lead: timeline check: procurement lead = 6–10 weeks for purchase; lease ops can be live in 2–3 weeks. getting capacity in APAC still earliest ~10 weeks.
jamal: action items:
- @katie produce P&L (low/med/high) by 12:00
- @anya finalize hardware spec + sizing doc
- @maria prototype embedding offload plan and estimate hours saved
- @finance confirm capex approval path
we'll reconvene 16:00 for final vote. :thumbsup:
katie: noted, will post spreadsheet link when ready.
ops-bot: reminder set: reconvene thread at 16:00
maria: quick note—we should also include network egress bucket in rollout; otherwise cost surprises.
jamal: agreed. thanks all.
